vocabulary.structure: SEPIO assertion / evidence line / evidence item

evidence: Measured in 1 of 6 MONDAYS hemp SKUs at 0.06% of total volatiles (0.012mg per chew).

consumer_summary.what_it_is: Pseudolimonene is a volatile monoterpene, sharing a close chemical relationship with the bright, citrusy molecule limonene. It contributes to the complex aromas of several fragrant herbs and spices, meaning you might encounter it when crushing fresh mint leaves or preparing sweet ginger.
consumer_summary.found_in: It has been identified in the essential oils of familiar culinary and medicinal plants, including Perilla frutescens (shiso) and sweet ginger, as well as several members of the mint family.
consumer_summary.why_researchers_care: Researchers are drawn to pseudolimonene to map the active components of traditionally used aromatic plants. They are exploring how it might contribute to the free-radical scavenging abilities of essential oils. Currently, research is in the earliest stages of chemical screening, with no formal clinical or preclinical evidence yet established.

structure_function.statement: Pseudolimonene is being studied for its potential to support cellular defenses against free radicals.
structure_function.basis: This rests on a single paper screening the chemical composition and radical-scavenging mechanisms of sweet ginger essential oil.

hypothesized_benefits.hypothesis: Researchers are exploring whether pseudolimonene actively contributes to the antioxidant capacity of the essential oils it inhabits, which could make it a valuable component in natural preservatives or health-supporting botanical extracts.
hypothesized_benefits.study_to_test_it: An in vitro assay isolating pseudolimonene to measure its direct DPPH and ABTS radical scavenging activity compared to standard antioxidants like Trolox, followed by cell-based assays to observe its effect on oxidative stress markers.

consumer_summary.evidence_at_a_glance: Research on pseudolimonene is still in its infancy, with no formal evidence levels established beyond basic chemical profiling of plant essential oils.
